search.label: Search nodes
search.placeholder: Search by name, address or label

noManager.title: No manager is connected
noManager.body: Node changes are off until a manager node's agent reconnects. You can still look at what Bayplan last saw.

gone.heading: This node is gone
gone.body: It left the swarm or was removed. Go back to the list to find it.

engineLabels.title: Engine labels
engineLabels.caption: Set in the node's Docker daemon settings. Bayplan can't change them.

tasks.capped: Older tasks are left out. The swarm holds {{total, number}} for this node.

empty.title: No tasks on this node
empty.body: Tasks the swarm places here show up as they are created.

error.title: Couldn't load the tasks of this node.
error.body: Docker may be unreachable. Try again.

labels.title: Node labels
labels.helper: Services use labels in placement constraints, such as node.labels.disk==ssd.

problem.keyTooLong: A label name can be at most 256 bytes.
problem.valueTooLong: A label value can be at most 4096 bytes.
problem.tooMany: A node can have at most 64 labels.

impact.title: Effect on services
impact.summary_one: Swarm may move {{count, number}} task off this node.
impact.summary_other: Swarm may move {{count, number}} tasks off this node.
impact.empty: No service uses these labels in a placement constraint.
impact.failed: Couldn't check which services use these labels.

confirm.title: Apply label changes?
confirm.body_one: {{count, number}} service has a constraint this node would no longer meet. Swarm moves its tasks to other nodes, or leaves them pending if no node matches.
confirm.body_other: {{count, number}} services have constraints this node would no longer meet. Swarm moves their tasks to other nodes, or leaves them pending if no node matches.

refusal.node_changed: This node changed after you started editing. Nothing was saved. Check the services below and save again.

inspect.loadFailed: Couldn't load the inspect document of {{name}}.

nodes.noManagerReason: No manager is connected, so swarm changes are off.

action.loadFailed: Couldn't check what this will do. Try again.
action.gone: {{name}} is no longer in the swarm.

drain.title: Drain {{name}}?
drain.body: Swarm stops sending tasks to it and moves the ones it has to other nodes.

pause.title: Pause {{name}}?
pause.body: Swarm stops sending new tasks to it.
pause.tasks_one: The {{count, number}} task already there keeps running.
pause.tasks_other: The {{count, number}} tasks already there keep running.

promote.title: Promote {{name}} to manager?
promote.body: Managers keep the swarm's state and answer API calls.

warning.even_count: With {{n, number}} managers the swarm tolerates losing {{losses, number}}, the same as with {{fewer, number}}. An odd number is better.
warning.quorum_at_risk: Only {{reachable, number}} of {{total, number}} managers are reachable. Demoting this one could leave the swarm without a majority, and it would stop accepting changes.
warning.runs_bayplan: Bayplan runs on {{name}}. {{doing}} it can cut Bayplan off from this swarm.
warning.only_manager_agent: {{name}} has the only manager agent connected to Bayplan. {{doing}} it leaves Bayplan unable to change this swarm until another manager's agent connects.
warning.facts_unreadable: Bayplan couldn't check the managers' state, so it can't tell whether this is safe.

refusal.last_manager: You can't demote the last manager. Promote another node first.
refusal.node_changed: That changed while you were looking at it. Reload the page and try again.
refusal.node_not_found: {{name}} is no longer in the swarm.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: {{name}} is down, so Swarm forgets it. If it comes back, it has to join the swarm again. Bayplan also marks its agent as gone.

reason.notDown: Only a node that is down can be removed.

refusal.node_not_down: {{name}} isn't down. Only a node that is down can be removed.
